data.summary: Reviews show strong evidence of authentic, predominantly negative customer experiences. The few positive reviews lack the specific detail and balanced critique typical of genuine feedback and may be inauthentic or outliers. A clear, long-standing pattern exists of poor communication, billing disputes, unprofessional service, and refusal to honor pre-job agreements. The company does not appear to stand behind its work.
fake_signals: Positive reviews are vague and generic (e.g., 'take pool service to the next level')
Positive reviews lack specific negative balance; all are uniformly glowing without minor critiques
Positive review from 'Gdub' for weekly service seems out of place with severe service complaints from others

negative_evidence: Refused to fix a pre-agreed socket replacement without a large additional charge ($900) after the job was done
Failed to address reported issues like broken equipment and poor cleaning

authentic_signals: Negative reviews contain highly specific details: names (Michael, Judy Lonteen), exact issues (broken skimmer lid, $900 socket charge, yellow water), and behaviors (technician napping, tire squealing)
Reviews span a long timeline (13 years to 3 years ago)
Writing styles and emotional tones vary significantly between reviews
complaint_patterns: Refusal to fix pre-discussed issues post-job
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant discrepancy between Google (3.2) and Yelp (1.9) ratings. The Yelp rating is much lower, suggesting a pattern of poor service that may be more accurately reflected there, or that dissatisfied customers are concentrated on that platform. The BBB B- rating with accreditation false also indicates business practice concerns.

reviews.text: We have had a really great experience with American Pacific Pools on our pool Reno which included replastering, tiling and coping.  Kelly, Michael and Gary provided amazing customer service and were always going the extra mile in addressing our concerns and patient with all the changes we had along the way.  We really appreciated their crew showing up every day on time and working hard.  The result is amazing!
reviews.author: Amy Perez

reviews.text: Everyone is so pleasant and professional. They explain things and answer questions very thoroughly. They take pride in cleaning pools and keeping them clean. They have so many options when renovating your pool too. They truly take pool service to the next level!
reviews.author: K McC

reviews.text:
Dishonest company.

Hired them to re-plaster my pool, told them I had one of the returns that had broken on the outside of the pool wall and I wanted the entire socket replaced.  Was told by Michael that it would not be a problem since they chisel out all the old sockets anyway.  Well they came and did the job and did nothing with that socket, then told me it would be another $900 if I wanted to have that done.

Zero integrity, dishonest company. Look elsewhere.

Follow up response to owner: Your salesman lied, that's the only way to put it. Spin however you want with what you said about the contract. When your sales guy tell me that it is standard practice to chisel them out then I am being misled to believe that is what you normally do. Instead you intentionally underbid the job to get the work then tried to charge more. Oh and your guy did chip out the back side of where that return was, leaving a huge chunk of the concrete gone. Be grateful I am not suing you for that damage.
reviews.author: Daniel CARNES

reviews.text: We have had American Pacific Pools for several years now and have been very satisfied with them.  We had them resurface and fill in our pool so that it is all close to 6' deep (originally over 10' in deepest part) .  They are very professional and take care of our pool every week....I like to deal with Judy Lonteen as she is "the best and very knowledgeable and pleasant to work with"..........
reviews.author: Marlene Jones

reviews.text: Been using American Pacific pools for over 5 years. Several issues with this company. Even when the technician isn't taking hour long naps in his truck in front of my house the 15 minutes of "cleaning" he does is substandard. I've called multiple times to complain, and been told someone will be in touch with me to resolve the issue. They did eventually replace the tech who was napping, but the cleaning has only gotten worse. Use American Pacific if you're looking forward to your pool being filled at the bottom with sand and the sides covered with grime year-round.
reviews.author: Steven Henson

reviews.text: Great service - we have had Ampac provide weekly service for our pool for almost a year now and they have always done a great job.  They let us know of issues that might come up and the pool is always crystal clear and ready to swim in during the season.  Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Gdub

reviews.text: The price was right, but the value wasn't.  1st time technician came out he broke the lid to the skimmer and never reported it.  Then, when I called and talked to 2 people about the broken skimmer lid and the poor job the technician was doing in cleaning the pool (we had seen no change in pool quality), we never heard a response.  Their service and communication were far below any credible pool cleaning service.  Don't waste your money.  Move on to the next pool service.
reviews.author: Craig Brown

reviews.text:
This company is extremely unprofessional. Not only do they give poor service, the idiots somehow turned my pool water yellow! It looks like a pool of urine! How in the world do you screw something like that up? Then the service person squealed his tires, in a company vehicle, out of my driveway.
This is extremely unacceptable behavior from anyone.
I will not be using this company again. If one could give negative stars, I would.
Please,  for the live off God and country, move on top the next pool service, don't waste your time or money!
reviews.author: Raymond Reddington
